You are working in a Go repository checked out at /gin (the gin web framework). Do NOT modify any file. Only run read-only commands and report findings.

Tasks:
1. Run `cd /gin && git log --oneline -15` and `cd /gin && git status --porcelain` and report the exact output.
2. Run `cd /gin && git diff HEAD~1 --stat` (if it fails, say so) and report output.
3. Run `cd /gin && go build ./... 2>&1 | head -30` and report.
4. Run the full test suite: `cd /gin && go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -80` and report the complete output, clearly listing which test packages FAIL and the names of any failing tests.
5. Also run `cd /gin && go test -run 'TestResponseWriter|TestError|TestRouter|TestTree|TestRoute' -v . 2>&1 | tail -100` and report which tests fail.

Report everything verbatim in a concise structured summary: git log output, git status, build result, list of failing tests (package + test name), and any compile errors. Do not attempt to fix anything.

You are working in a Go repository checked out at /gin (the gin web framework). Investigate a bug and report the exact mechanism, with evidence from running code. You may create ONE temporary test file at /gin/zz_repro_params_test.go and run it, but you MUST delete it again at the end (the repository must be left exactly as you found it, apart from nothing).

Bug report from a user: registering routes at runtime (after the server has already handled a request) leads to empty URL parameters. Reproduction:

```go
router := gin.New()
// first request, before the route exists -> 404
w := httptest.NewRecorder()
req := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/test/john/smith/is/super/great", nil)
router.ServeHTTP(w, req) // 404

router.GET("/test/:name/:last_name/*wild", func(c *gin.Context) {
    // c.Param("name") is "" but expected "john"
})

w2 := httptest.NewRecorder()
req2 := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/test/john/smith/is/super/great", nil)
router.ServeHTTP(w2, req2) // 200 but all params empty
```

Write that as a Go test in package `gin` in /gin/zz_repro_params_test.go (use github.com/stretchr/testify/assert or plain t.Fatalf), run `cd /gin && go test -run TestZZReproParams -v .` and report the output.

Then investigate the root cause in the source (read /gin/gin.go, /gin/tree.go, /gin/context.go) and explain precisely why params end up empty. In particular examine: Engine.allocateContext (uses engine.maxParams), Engine.addRoute (updates engine.maxParams), node.getValue in tree.go (the `if params != nil && cap(*params) > 0` condition), and Context.reset. Report the exact code path and the exact line numbers.

Finally, DELETE /gin/zz_repro_params_test.go and confirm with `cd /gin && git status --porcelain` that the tree is clean.

Report: (a) the test output showing the bug, (b) the precise root cause with file:line references, (c) confirmation the temp file was deleted and git status is clean.
